name: Northwest Ridge
overview: Usually a winter route, beginning from Annette Lake or from the lot at Hyak. Annette Lake is generally preferred as the shorter way, while the Hyak side is less complicated because much of it follows cross-country trails. The ridge can be gained on its west, its north or its east flank; the east is the most gradual and unexposed. Parties generally change to boots or crampons on the ridge, with minimal exposure. When unsure, dodge obstacles by ducking to the west. The summit is spacious with 360 degree views. Beware of cornices on the ridge and summit.
